user.title: Connect an AI provider
user.description: Get a key from [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys), [DeepSeek](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys), or [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys). API billing and quotas are managed by the provider. Saving makes a small model and tool-calling check. The key is stored in this Home Assistant installation.

error.invalid_provider: Choose one of the supported providers.
error.invalid_auth: The key was rejected. Check API access and your key.
error.invalid_model: The model request was rejected. Check its name and tool support.
error.tools_unsupported: The model did not call the test tool. Choose a tool-capable model.
error.quota: The provider reported a balance or request limit. Check billing and quotas.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the provider.
error.invalid_response: The provider returned an unexpected response.
error.assistant_busy: The assistant is busy. Wait for the current command to finish.
error.assistant_failed: The request could not finish. Check device states: some actions may have completed.

abort.setup_failed: Settings saved, but the integration failed to start.
